info.name: AI Agent Identity System - Complete E2E Test Suite
info.description:
Comprehensive Postman collection for testing the AI Agent Identity System.

## Version: 2.0 (Phase 2)

## Phase 2 Updates:
- Storage Adapter Pattern (PostgreSQL/Redis/In-Memory)
- Detailed Health Endpoint with storage/features info
- Trust Registry Stats with storageType
- Revocation Stats endpoint
- Audit Stats endpoint
- API Key authentication support

## Test Flow Order:
1. Health & Setup ✅
2. Authentication ✅
3. Issuer Operations ✅
4. Holder Operations ✅
5. Verifier Operations ✅
6. Trust Registry ✅
7. Revocation ✅
8. Audit Logs ✅
9. Backup & Restore ✅
10. SD-JWT ✅
11. Metrics ✅

## E2E Flow Test:
Auth → Offer → Token → Credential → VP → Verified ✅

## Authentication Methods:
- Bearer Token: `Authorization: Bearer {{auth_token}}`
- API Key: `X-API-Key: {{api_key}}`

## Environment Variables:
- `base_url`: API base URL (default: http://localhost:3000)
- `api_key`: API Key for authentication
- `auth_token`: JWT token (auto-set after login)
- `pre_auth_code`: Pre-authorized code (auto-set)
- `vci_access_token`: VCI access token (auto-set)
- `credential_jwt`: Issued credential (auto-set)
- `session_id`: Verification session ID (auto-set)
- `vp_state`: Verification state (auto-set)
- `vp_nonce`: Verification nonce (auto-set)
- `sdjwt_credential`: SD-JWT credential (auto-set)
